name: Creature of the Void
summary: In the Undercity, a lost grimoire holds the key to summoning a voidwalker. Forsaken warlocks must recover Egalin's Grimoire from the Scarlet Crusade in western Tirisfal Glades to learn how to summon and bind one.

sections.title: A Teacher's Legacy
sections.body: Carendin Halgar guides Forsaken summoners in the Temple of the Damned. When an acolyte can wield more than the power of petty imps, Halgar points them toward the voidwalker, a creature forged from pure shadow and chaos. Forsaken warlocks rely on the careful research of Egalin, Halgar's former master, who wrote the rituals for subduing these beings of the void.

sections.title: The Stolen Grimoire
sections.body: Egalin's Grimoire holds the methods for channeling the volatile magic needed to master a voidwalker. Perrine, a Scarlet Crusade zealot stationed in an outpost tower to the west, stole the book. The Crusade may see it only as blasphemous contraband to seize and hoard, but recovering it gives the Forsaken the ritual secrets they need before they try to tear open the veil.

faq.answer: Egalin's Grimoire is a magical manual written by Egalin, Carendin Halgar's teacher. It describes the channeling techniques and spells needed to breach the void and summon a voidwalker under the caster's control.

faq.q: Why did the Scarlet Crusade steal the book?
aliases: why did scarlet crusade take it
faq.answer: The Scarlet Crusade considers demonic and shadow magic corrupt. Perrine seized the grimoire and hid it in a western watchtower in Tirisfal Glades, seemingly unaware of the summoning power it holds.

Carendin Halgar is a master warlock trainer in the Temple of the Damned in the Undercity. He guides novice Forsaken warlocks, teaching respect for volatile cosmic forces and caution from his own past summoning mistakes.

faq.q: What happens if a warlock loses control of a voidwalker?
faq.answer: Voidwalkers are beings of pure chaos and shadow. Carendin Halgar warns that without flawless discipline and binding will, a conjured voidwalker will violently tear its summoner apart.

faq.q: What comes after recovering the grimoire?
faq.answer: Once Halgar has the book, he studies it and teaches you the ritual runes. Then you enter The Binding, where you use the summoning circle to conjure a voidwalker and defeat it in personal combat to establish dominance.

faq.q: Where is the Scarlet Crusade outpost located?
faq.answer: The Scarlet Crusade outpost is a watchtower west across Tirisfal Glades. Crusaders under Perrine guard it, and the grimoire is hidden inside.

angles.text: As a warlock, you move beyond dabbling with imps toward controlling heavy frontline shadow entities that can absorb immense physical punishment.
As an Undead, you strike the Scarlet Crusade to reclaim dark knowledge, deepening the bitter struggle between the Forsaken and the living zealots occupying Lordaeron's ruins.
As a member of the Horde, you learn how the Undercity's dark arts use strict scholarship to turn dangerous planar forces into reliable assets in the Horde's frontier wars.
